ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Käpp uses your location to show the nearest dog parks and how far away they are. Your location is never shared with others without your permission.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Käpp needs access to your photos so you can choose pictures for your dog’s profile. Location data is removed from photos before they are saved.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Käpp uses the camera so you can take photos of your dog. Location data is removed from photos before they are saved.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Käpp uses your location only while the app is open, to show the nearest dog parks. Your location is never tracked in the background.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Käpp uses your location only while the app is open, to show the nearest dog parks. Your location is never tracked in the background.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: Käpp does not use motion data. The location module requires this text to be present.
